maneder.en: Cold, good snow. Dog sledding, northern lights and longer days.

Warmest (20 °C). Midnight sun, hiking and paddling.

maneder.en: Mild, fewer mosquitoes. Northern lights return towards the end.

maneder.en: Ruska (see events) and northern lights over open water.

maneder.en: Dark and grey, little snow. Northern lights between the clouds.
The snow arrives, polar night approaching.

maneder.no: Mørketid, snø og julenisse i Rovaniemi. Dyrt og fullt.
maneder.en: Polar night, snow and Santa in Rovaniemi. Expensive and full.
